author: Murphh
body:
Hi all - I've made a skywars map, Cloud Village,  that is a mixture of skywars and team death match (TDM).  

video: https://youtu.be/dTWjtUUxSPo
pictures: http://imgur.com/a/XFzCc

  • Teams - two teams with between 2-20 players per team
  • Objective - team with most kills within 10 minutes or 100 kills (whichever first)
  • Kill reward - 1 ender pearl
  • Chests random - but I want some specialty items in certain chests (don't know if possible)
Here is some feedback already:
  • islands are too far apart
I made the islands far apart because I want bridging and ender pearls to be the main way to islands. I want to put specialty items on farther away islands as an incentive to go there.

Questions I have:
  • Plains - The map is located in the plains biome and it rains all the time.  Is there a way to add /toggledownfall into xml or just have it never rain?  Or if I save the map during no rain there will never be any?  I don't know much about this.
  • Chests - Can the map have both random chests and chests that already have specialty items in it? Is this possible?  I don't know how to do xml, if it is possible.
  • Spawns - I don't know how to protect spawns.  I've looked at other xml and I'm still confused.  I think I want the cuboid shape, but I don't know really.
  • VOID - Since I don't have world edit, I downloaded a skywars map from the internet to tear down and build up again, but now I have grass plains floating in the void and it looks ugly.  How do I remove that?  I don't have world edit, but will that fix it?  Again, I know nothing of this.
Please help with this map!!! Thanks for your input!!!
